purpose: End-to-end learned-world-model mechanism diagnosis and intervention-readiness test

environments.state_interface: actual single-system observed joint q, qdot, action; no paired nominal-system internals
actual single-system observed generalized coordinates/velocities and action; no paired nominal-system internals

world_models.architecture: Residual MLP, 3 hidden layers x 128, SiLU

randomized_factors: body/link mass within declared train/test ranges

allowed_diagnostic_input: residuals r_t = y_{t+1} - f_hat(y_t,u_t) from the evaluated learned world model
world-model predictive ensemble disagreement if available from independent seeds
declared physical reference measurements acquired by the diagnostic policy
calibration statistics frozen from nominal held-out residuals
forbidden_diagnostic_input: difference between a nominal MuJoCo instance and a faulty MuJoCo instance
direct qacc difference between nominal and fault simulators
analytic injected Gaussian noise as the sole evidence of empirical calibration

evidence_stages.E0: passive same-channel learned-model residual history only
evidence_stages.E1: E0 + one rank-1 independent reference direction
evidence_stages.E2: E0 + full-rank independent reference for static mechanism split
evidence_stages.D2: learned-model residuals after two frozen diagnostic operating points
evidence_stages.D3: learned-model residuals after three affinely independent frozen diagnostic operating points

uncertainty.primary: empirical calibration from held-out nominal learned-model residuals
uncertainty.method: split-conformal/selective threshold on intervention risk; covariance/whitening reported descriptively
uncertainty.gaussian_theory: secondary diagnostic only; never used as empirical validation unless held-out residual diagnostics support it

primary_metrics: wrong intervention risk among committed cases
mean diagnostic evidence/probe cost to safe commitment

sealed_gates.P0_world_model_quality: >=7/8 models per environment meet both frozen quality thresholds
sealed_gates.P1_static_below_threshold_ambiguity: on matched encoder-vs-mechanical pure faults, best generic held-out classifier AUC <=0.65 under E0 and E1
sealed_gates.P2_static_full_rank_resolution: under E2, MEC/structured correct intervention >=0.90, wrong-intervention risk <=0.05, coverage >=0.80
sealed_gates.P4_dynamic_threshold_resolution: under D3, correct intervention >=0.90, wrong-intervention risk <=0.05, coverage >=0.80
sealed_gates.P5_selective_end_to_end: on all pure hidden faults, MEC wrong-intervention risk <=0.05 at coverage >=0.70
sealed_gates.P6_ood_safety: combined/OOV wrong pure-intervention rate <=0.05 and abstain/escalate rate >=0.80
sealed_gates.P7_evidence_efficiency: at matched <=5% wrong-intervention risk, MEC uses <=0.85x mean diagnostic probe cost of RANDOM_PROBE_EQUAL_BUDGET; report comparison to active model discrimination without requiring superiority
sealed_gates.P8_cross_family: P2/P4/P5 directional conclusions hold in both environment families; if confirmatory environment fails, no cross-family robotics claim
sealed_gates.P9_seed_stability: no more than 1 of 8 world-model seeds may violate P5 by >2 percentage points; all three hidden-test seeds are reported
sealed_gates.P10_no_posthoc: all seeds, splits, thresholds, fault ranges, metrics and gates remain unchanged after first hidden unseal

decision_rule.PARTIAL_NARROW: core theory-aligned structural gates pass but one or more generalization/baseline/safety gates fail; narrow paper to passed scope
decision_rule.FAIL_END_TO_END: P1/P2/P3/P4/P5 fails materially; do not claim MEC works end-to-end for learned world models

reporting.confidence_intervals: paired bootstrap 95% CI over hidden scenarios, stratified by mechanism and model seed
reporting.auc_ci: DeLong or paired bootstrap; use paired bootstrap if implementation dependency unavailable

data_generation.action_policy_train: piecewise-constant random controls; segment length uniformly 1..5 steps

fault_ranges.fault_sign: independent symmetric +/- unless vector direction is explicitly constructed

static_threshold_pair.note: adversarial threshold arm only; generic hidden static faults use uniformly random 2D direction

dynamic_threshold_points_inverted_double.cart_state: 0 position, 0 velocity unless Gymnasium health constraints require epsilon-safe deterministic adjustment logged before any hidden fault labels are read

morphology_and_nuisance_ranges.note: the same nuisance generator is present in nominal calibration data; Gaussian trial injection is not part of the primary E2E evaluation

diagnostic_method.name: MEC_SELECTIVE_V1
diagnostic_method.fit_data: development fault set only; hidden seeds inaccessible until final evaluation
diagnostic_method.fault_detection_score: whitened learned-world-model residual energy using nominal calibration residual covariance with ridge 1e-6
diagnostic_method.static_split: use learned-model residual history for fault evidence plus declared independent reference measurement; full-rank reference supports mechanical-vs-encoder action split
diagnostic_method.dynamic_split: fit centered affine residual model R(v)=A v+s from learned-model one-step residual summaries at frozen operating points; compare dynamics term ||A|| and intercept term ||s||
diagnostic_method.selective_commitment: mechanism action score must be uniquely maximal and exceed a threshold selected on development/calibration data to target <=5% wrong-intervention risk; otherwise abstain/acquire evidence
diagnostic_method.threshold_selection: choose smallest score threshold on development data whose one-sided Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bound on wrong-intervention risk is <=0.05; if none exists, always abstain for that stage

ACTIVE_MODEL_DISCRIMINATION.objective: maximize minimum pairwise standardized separation between development-fitted mechanism residual predictors
ACTIVE_MODEL_DISCRIMINATION.optimizer: enumerate frozen candidate pool; deterministic tie break by candidate index

ORACLE.description: full allowed evidence stages plus true sufficient evidence allocation; never receives true mechanism label for prediction, only upper-bound probe allocation
